rows.description: You want to text them at night. Wise: decide about contact consciously, mute if needed, and let time do its work. Immature: testing if they still care or using friends to keep tabs.

rows.description: You try friendship but one of you still hopes. Wise: honestly ask whether it hurts more than helps and give it distance first. Immature: staying close to keep a door open.

rows.description: You replay how they wronged you and feel bitter. Wise: allow anger as information, then let it go for your own peace. Harmful: spreading their private matters or turning friends against them.

rows.description: An ex keeps contacting you after you said no. Wise: say a clear final no, block, save evidence, and tell family, friends or authorities. It is not your fault and safety comes first.

rows.description: You cannot stop watching their life and feel unable to move on. Wise: recognise this as pain, not love, and seek support such as a friend or counsellor. Harmful: showing up, monitoring or threatening.

rows.description: Parents learn of the relationship and the breakup and judge you. Wise: seek compassion, tell only what you choose, and see this as learning, not disgrace. Immature: lying deeper or shutting down.

rows.description: You bump into your ex at a friend's gathering. Wise: be polite, brief and calm; you owe neither a scene nor a friendship. Immature: performing happiness or sniping.

rows.description: Months later you can think of them without hurt. Wise: take lessons about your patterns and needs, without rewriting the past as all bad or all good. Immature: swearing off love.

rows.description: You want closeness and must ask and listen, not assume. Wise: consent is clear, freely given and can change; a hesitation or silence is not a yes. Harmful: pressure, guilt or persistence.
